summary.text: Drew Cranmer is a data engineer and small-business founder from Wichita running as the Libertarian Party candidate. He describes himself as not a career politician and is running on restoring Congress's constitutional war and spending powers and devolving policy to the states.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a data engineer, small-business founder, husband and father from Wichita.
Says he has spent his career building data pipelines and software, and that he has investigated warrantless license plate surveillance in his community.
